query:
UPDATE pending_auth_summaries
                  SET pa_cust_id = $2,
                      pa_auth_status = $3,
                      pa_account_status = $4,
                      pa_credit_limit = $5,
                      pa_cash_limit = $6,
                      pa_credit_balance = $7,
                      pa_cash_balance = $8,
                      pa_approved_auth_cnt = $9,
                      pa_declined_auth_cnt = $10,
                      pa_approved_auth_amt = $11,
                      pa_declined_auth_amt = $12
                WHERE pa_acct_id = $1
